verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a terminal app, since users may want to export profiles, settings and history. However, the evidence pack documents no export of user data in open formats. Saving paste history to disk and the Python/AppleScript APIs are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
